title: 部署時進行中的結帳被切斷

claims.claim: tag `ep11` 的 `cmd/api/main.go` 只監聽 `os.Interrupt`，不監聽 `SIGTERM`；收到取消之後直接 `return srv.Close()`。tag `ep12` 的 `cmd/api/main.go` 同時監聽 `os.Interrupt` 與 `syscall.SIGTERM`。
claims.claim_en: At tag `ep11`, `cmd/api/main.go` listens only for `os.Interrupt`, not `SIGTERM`, and on cancel it goes straight to `return srv.Close()`. At tag `ep12`, `cmd/api/main.go` listens for both `os.Interrupt` and `syscall.SIGTERM`.

claims.claim: `lifecycle.Serve` 收到取消之後呼叫 `srv.Shutdown`，並且等 `Serve` 回傳才結束。測試 `TestServeLetsAnInFlightRequestFinishBeforeReturning` 證明：取消之後，進行中的請求照樣收到完整回應，`Serve` 回傳 `nil`。把 `srv.Shutdown` 換成 `srv.Close`，這個測試就失敗。
claims.claim_en: After cancel, `lifecycle.Serve` calls `srv.Shutdown` and waits for the serve goroutine to return. The test `TestServeLetsAnInFlightRequestFinishBeforeReturning` proves that a request already running still gets its full response and `Serve` returns `nil`. Replacing `srv.Shutdown` with `srv.Close` makes that test fail.

edit.new: if err := srv.Close(); err != nil || shutdownCtx == nil {

claims.claim: 傳給 `Shutdown` 的 context 由 `context.WithoutCancel` 加一個逾時組成，不是已經被取消的訊號 context。測試 `TestServeRefusesNewConnectionsOnceShutdownStarts` 證明關機開始後新連線被拒絕；測試 `TestServeCutsConnectionsWhenGraceRunsOut` 證明寬限時間用完還沒做完，連線被切斷，錯誤包含 `context.DeadlineExceeded`。
claims.claim_en: The context passed to `Shutdown` is built from `context.WithoutCancel` plus a timeout, not from the already-cancelled signal context. The test `TestServeRefusesNewConnectionsOnceShutdownStarts` proves that new connections are refused once shutdown starts; the test `TestServeCutsConnectionsWhenGraceRunsOut` proves that when the grace period runs out the connection is cut and the error wraps `context.DeadlineExceeded`.

checks.text: ctx is already cancelled, so the drain needs its own clock, or Shutdown would give up on its first line.

claims.claim: `Shutdown` 一開始，`srv.Serve` 就回傳 `http.ErrServerClosed`。`lifecycle.Serve` 先等 `Shutdown` 回來，才讀取並檢查這個錯誤。
claims.claim_en: As soon as `Shutdown` starts, `srv.Serve` returns `http.ErrServerClosed`. `lifecycle.Serve` waits for `Shutdown` to return first, and only then reads and checks that error.

checks.text: // The trap this function exists for: the moment Shutdown starts, srv.Serve returns http.ErrServerClosed.

claims.claim: `lifecycle.Group` 的 context 從 `context.Background()` 建立，不是從訊號 context 建立；`Stop` 取消這個 context，再等每一個 goroutine 回來。`cmd/api/main.go` 把寄信的 `dispatcher.Run`、清過期訂單的 `janitor.Run`、搶購的 `sale.Run` 交給同一個 `Group`；搶購只在設定 `FLASH_SALE_PRODUCT_ID` 時才啟動。tag `ep11` 的背景 goroutine 用 `context.WithCancel(ctx)`，是從訊號 context 長出來的。測試 `TestGroupStopWaitsForEveryGoroutine` 證明 `Stop` 會等。
claims.claim_en: The context of `lifecycle.Group` is built from `context.Background()`, not from the signal context; `Stop` cancels it and then waits for every goroutine to return. `cmd/api/main.go` hands the mail `dispatcher.Run`, the expiry `janitor.Run` and the flash-sale `sale.Run` to one `Group`; the flash sale starts only when `FLASH_SALE_PRODUCT_ID` is set. At tag `ep11` the background goroutines used `context.WithCancel(ctx)`, so they grew out of the signal context. The test `TestGroupStopWaitsForEveryGoroutine` proves that `Stop` waits.

claims.claim: `serveThenStop` 只有兩個動作，順序是先 `lifecycle.Serve`，再 `workers.Stop`；`run` 呼叫的就是 `serveThenStop`。測試 `TestStopSignalLetsQueuedBuyersFinish`：一個 worker、客人 A 卡在資料庫、客人 B 在佇列，訊號來了之後兩位都收到 201。把這兩行對調，這個測試就失敗。
claims.claim_en: `serveThenStop` does two things, in this order: `lifecycle.Serve`, then `workers.Stop`; `run` calls exactly `serveThenStop`. The test `TestStopSignalLetsQueuedBuyersFinish`: one worker, buyer A stuck in the database, buyer B in the queue; after the stop signal both get 201. Swapping the two lines makes this test fail.

edit.old:
err := lifecycle.Serve(ctx, srv, ln, grace)
	workers.Stop()
edit.new:
workers.Stop()
	err := lifecycle.Serve(ctx, srv, ln, grace)

checks.text: Stop them first and that buyer is turned away mid-purchase.
B would be turned away with a 503

claims.claim: 排空的預設上限是 25 秒，可用環境變數 `SHUTDOWN_GRACE_SECONDS` 改。`docker-compose.yml` 的 `api` 服務把 `stop_grace_period` 設成 40 秒。程式註解寫明：`docker stop` 預設等 10 秒，40 秒是 25 秒排空加最多 5 秒沖出 span。`main.go` 沖出 span 的逾時是 5 秒。
claims.claim_en: The default drain limit is 25 seconds and can be changed with the environment variable `SHUTDOWN_GRACE_SECONDS`. The `api` service in `docker-compose.yml` sets `stop_grace_period` to 40 seconds. Code comments say `docker stop` waits 10 seconds by default, and that 40 seconds is the 25-second drain plus up to 5 seconds to flush spans. The span flush timeout in `main.go` is 5 seconds.

checks.text: 25 s drain + up to 5 s span flush
docker stop waits 10 s by default
sends SIGKILL in the middle of our graceful shutdown.

claims.claim: `run` 裡的 `defer` 註冊順序是：先 flush span、再 `pool.Close`、再 `rdb.Close`、最後 `workers.Stop`。函式結束時 `defer` 反向執行，所以先停 worker，再關 Redis、關資料庫連線池，最後沖出 span。
claims.claim_en: In `run` the `defer` calls are registered in this order: flush spans, `pool.Close`, `rdb.Close`, `workers.Stop`. Defers run in reverse, so the workers stop first, then Redis closes, then the database pool closes, and the spans are flushed last.

claims.claim: `Dockerfile` 有兩個階段：第一階段 `FROM golang:${GO_VERSION}-alpine AS build` 編譯，最後一階段是 `FROM scratch`，只複製憑證檔與 `/out/api` 兩樣東西。`go.mod` 與 `go.sum` 在 `COPY . .` 之前先複製並 `go mod download`。編譯指令有 `CGO_ENABLED=0`。`USER` 是 `65532:65532`，`ENTRYPOINT` 是陣列寫法 `["/api"]`，而且沒有 `HEALTHCHECK` 指令。
claims.claim_en: The `Dockerfile` has two stages: the first, `FROM golang:${GO_VERSION}-alpine AS build`, compiles; the last is `FROM scratch` and copies only two things, the certificate file and `/out/api`. `go.mod` and `go.sum` are copied and `go mod download` runs before `COPY . .`. The build command sets `CGO_ENABLED=0`. `USER` is `65532:65532`, `ENTRYPOINT` is the array form `["/api"]`, and there is no `HEALTHCHECK` instruction.

checks.pattern:
COPY go\.mod go\.sum \./
RUN go mod download

COPY \. \.

checks.text: # go.mod and go.sum first: this layer is rebuilt only when dependencies change, not on every source edit.
which is the only kind that runs on scratch.
Exec form (a JSON array) makes /api PID 1, so docker stop's SIGTERM reaches the Go program directly.
# No HEALTHCHECK on purpose: scratch has no shell and no curl to run one with.
# scratch has no /etc/passwd, so the user is a bare number: not root, and nothing to look up.

claims.claim: 測試 `TestDockerfileKeepsTheShutdownPromises` 讀 `Dockerfile` 的文字，只守三件事：最後一階是 `FROM scratch`、`ENTRYPOINT` 是陣列寫法、編譯有 `CGO_ENABLED=0`。它不編譯 image，所以不證明 image 能啟動。三件事各改掉一件，這個測試都會失敗。
claims.claim_en: The test `TestDockerfileKeepsTheShutdownPromises` reads the text of the `Dockerfile` and guards three things only: the last stage is `FROM scratch`, `ENTRYPOINT` is the array form, and the build sets `CGO_ENABLED=0`. It does not build an image, so it does not prove the image starts. Breaking any one of the three makes the test fail.

checks.text: // TestDockerfileKeepsTheShutdownPromises reads the Dockerfile as text. It does not build an image;

claims.claim: Go 的 `http.Server` 提供 `Shutdown`（優雅關閉）與 `Close`（立刻關閉）兩個方法，由程式自己決定順序。C# 的 .NET Generic Host 提供 `IHostApplicationLifetime`，用來處理優雅關機的工作。Spring Boot 預設啟用優雅關機，等待期限用 `spring.lifecycle.timeout-per-shutdown-phase` 設定。
claims.claim_en: Go's `http.Server` offers `Shutdown` (graceful) and `Close` (immediate), and the program decides the order. The C# .NET Generic Host provides `IHostApplicationLifetime` for graceful-shutdown work. Spring Boot enables graceful shutdown by default, and its wait is set with `spring.lifecycle.timeout-per-shutdown-phase`.

claims.claim: `docker stop` 先對容器的主行程送 SIGTERM，等過寬限時間之後再送 SIGKILL。
claims.claim_en: `docker stop` first sends SIGTERM to the container's main process and, after a grace period, sends SIGKILL.
